title: Resolve dashboard lodash Snyk findings via dependency update
description: Fix remaining Snyk dashboard npm findings SNYK-JS-LODASH-15869619 and SNYK-JS-LODASH-15869625 (aws-amplify -> @aws-amplify/notifications -> lodash) with a safe dependency update and validate via snyk test on apps/dashboard/package-lock.json.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented dashboard fix path: bumped aws-amplify to ^6.16.4 and refreshed apps/dashboard lockfile, which pulls @aws-amplify/notifications 2.0.94 and lodash 4.18.1 on the vulnerable path. Validation: snyk test --file=apps/dashboard/package-lock.json --package-manager=npm => no known vulnerabilities; snyk test --all-projects => no vulnerable paths found.
